Desktop apps get a title bar of their own, and every button and Look selector in the family can now wear a glyph. On Windows and Linux the bar is drawn in the app's look, while macOS keeps its own. The Labels selector gets new glyphs and a Row height selector three of its own. Buttons that only had words get theirs, so the Glyph choice of the label setting reaches them too. Twenty-three glyphs join the assortment, four meanings move off the glyphs they shared, and `IconSignIn` turns so its arrow points into the door. `IconUnlink` and `IconSleep` join the assortment, `IconUpdate` also covers the update check, a passkey sign-in wears `IconKey`, and the Version card shows its numbers without a "v". Bars that change all the time get a class of their own. Select becomes the one dropdown that can do everything. It splits its list into groups with headings, opens submenus beside their rows, carries a glyph per option and takes one of three sizes and four widths. An outside label can name it and a long value can wrap. The wheel steps it while it has focus, it stays busy while an answer is out and shakes when one is refused. It mirrors under a right-to-left language, gives a finger taller rows and keeps still under reduced motion. The design language has a section of its own for it.

**Adopting apps:**

- **Desktop window frame:** make the main window frameless on Windows and Linux and render `reference/react/WindowBar.tsx` only there, with the app's own window calls. Copy the window frame rules from `reference/tokens.css`, mark the frame that holds the rail and the content with `.glim-shell`, and size a full-height shell and anything fixed to the top edge with `--window-bar`.
- **Window glyphs:** copy `reference/react/glyphs.tsx` again, and take `IconWindowMinimise`, `IconWindowMaximise` and `IconWindowRestore` from `reference/glyphs.json` where the app has a title bar.
- **Look glyphs:** copy `IconLabelText`, `IconLabelTextGlyph`, `IconLabelGlyph` and `IconLabelReactive` from `reference/glyphs.json` again and put them on the Labels selector's segments. An app with a Row height selector takes `IconRowCompact`, `IconRowMedium` and `IconRowComfortable` for it.
- **Button glyphs:** copy `IconSignIn` from `reference/glyphs.json` again, and take the new glyphs where the app has those buttons. `reference/glyph-map.md` says which button moves where.
- **Label keys:** point retry, reload and refresh at `IconRetry` and a reset at `IconRefresh`, import and export at `IconImport` and `IconExport`, Done, Confirm and Got it at `IconConfirm`, decline at `IconReject`, apply at `IconApply` and undo at `IconUndo`.
- **Version card:** copy `reference/react/AboutCard.tsx` again. It shows "3.8.0" where the build hands it `v3.8.0`, and an app that prints a version anywhere else drops the "v" there too. The link keeps pointing at the tag.
- **What's new:** give the New button `IconWhatsNew`, with the green dot in front of the glyph.
- **Update check:** give Check for updates `IconUpdate`, and its answer `IconUpToDate` or `IconUpdateAvailable`.
- **Unlink:** copy `IconUnlink` from `reference/glyphs.json` for a button that drops a connection.
- **Sleep:** copy `IconSleep` for spinning a disk down, resting and hibernating, and keep `IconMoon` for the dark look alone.
- **Passkey:** give the button that signs in with a passkey `IconKey`.
- **Charts:** where the person picks the second series' colour, keep that colour and its fill.
- **Bars:** copy `.glim-meter` from `reference/tokens.css` and put it on every bar or meter that changes all the time, beside the class that gives it a height.
- **Tests:** run the end-to-end specs of a list in move mode with reduced motion. An app that checks rule 36 in its own code also reads Tailwind's `has-[…]` variants.
- **Selectors on a phone:** give a selector whose labels run long, such as the Labels selector, a way to set its segments two to a row below 600px: a wrapping strip that stretches its rows, each segment at `flex: 1 0 var(--seg-basis, auto)`, and `--seg-basis: calc(50% - 0.25rem)` under 600px. A label that does not fit its half wraps instead of being cut off.
- **Plugin pages:** gate the GlimStone look of a plugin page on `html.cc-popups-on`, which the companion plugin sets on every page.
- **A dropdown of the app's own** can stay. Check it against `reference/react/Select.tsx` and "The dropdown": its list takes typeahead, its rows are at least 44px on a touch screen, and it closes on the person's wheel or finger rather than on every scroll event, so a page that glides to a focused trigger does not shut the list as it opens.
- **Lists on `DropdownListbox`**, also those that draw their own trigger over it, move to `Select`. A language's flag goes in as the option's `glyph`, and the wheel comes built in. Install `@zag-js/react`, `@zag-js/select` and `@zag-js/menu`, and copy `reference/selectScroll.ts` beside the components folder.
- **A select field of the app's own** becomes `Select`, with `@zag-js/menu` installed. Stacked labels are `width="steady"`, and glyphs are the options' `glyph`. Groups and headings, a `null` value with a placeholder, `busy`, `shake`, `tip` and submenus come with it.
- **Every app:** copy the select rules from `reference/tokens.css` again. The open list is at least 13rem wide, under a narrow trigger too, at most 22rem, scrolls from 24rem and never runs past the window; this reaches the Combobox's list too.
- **Version:** copy `reference/react/version.ts` again.

## ✨ Added

- **The desktop window frame.** `WindowBar` is a strip to drag with minimise, maximise and close, and no mark or name, since the rail shows both. The page and a dialog's scrim start under the 2.5rem bar, so the window can still be moved and closed while a dialog is open. Windows 11's snap layouts do not open on the drawn maximise button.
- **Three window glyphs.** `IconWindowMinimise`, `IconWindowMaximise` and `IconWindowRestore`, drawn on the 14-unit grid and filling it like `IconClose`.
- **Three glyphs for a Row height selector.** `IconRowCompact`, `IconRowMedium` and `IconRowComfortable` are bars across the width, four close together, three, and two far apart.
- **Twenty-three glyphs for buttons that had none**, all from Streamline's free set: `IconRetry`, `IconImport`, `IconExport`, `IconConfirm`, `IconReject`, `IconApply`, `IconUndo`, `IconEmpty`, `IconForgotPassword`, `IconCompact`, `IconKeepBoth`, `IconKeepLeft`, `IconKeepRight`, `IconMerge`, `IconSendTest`, `IconStopAsking`, `IconCookies`, `IconLog`, `IconInstall`, `IconUpdate`, `IconUpToDate`, `IconUpdateAvailable` and `IconWhatsNew`. `IconUpToDate` is the cloud of `IconUpdate` with a tick, for the update check that found nothing new. `IconReject` is the thumb of `IconConfirm` mirrored to point down, and the gift of `IconWhatsNew` has its ribbon drawn as a filled shape instead of a line.
- **`IconUnlink`** for Unlink, drop a connection: Streamline's broken link, a chain with a slash through it like `IconEyeOff`, `IconKeyRevoke` and `IconShieldOff`.
- **`IconSleep`** for Sleep, spin down, rest, hibernate: Streamline's Zzz. Spin down and hibernate move to it from `IconMoon`.
- **`.glim-meter`** carries rule 37's `contain: size layout`, so a bar does not have to spell it out.
- **`check.sh` also reads Tailwind variants.** A `has-[…]` in a component's class list that tests the class or style attribute fails the check like a `:has()` in a stylesheet.
- **Move mode in end-to-end tests.** Playwright waits for a row to hold still before it clicks it, and a wiggling row never does, so those specs run with reduced motion.
- **Groups and headings.** `groups` splits the list into runs with a hairline between them, and a run with a heading is a named group for a screen reader.
- **Submenus.** An entry with `options` of its own opens them beside its row. A list with one runs on Zag's menu machine with radio items, since a listbox cannot nest.
- **Four widths.** `fill`, `steady`, `squeeze` and `hug`.
- **The wheel, built in.** A closed Select with focus steps through every option in list order, skipping disabled ones and stopping at both ends.
- **Three sizes.** `field`, `row` for a list or table row and `inset` inside another field.
- **An outside label and a long value.** `id` names the trigger for a `<label htmlFor>`, `ref` hands the caller its node, and `wrap` lets a value run onto a second line.
- **Glyphs, a placeholder, busy, shake and tip.** An option can carry a glyph, a `null` value shows the placeholder, `busy` keeps the focus and takes no input, each bump of `shake` shakes the trigger once, and `tip` gives a trigger without a label a hover bubble.
- **The framework-free mount takes groups, widths and the wheel.** `reference/select.ts` gets them too; submenus need the React component.
- **Twenty-one contract rows** for Select on the site, each a Playwright test, among them right to left, reduced motion and touch.

## 🎨 Design

- **The label glyphs are redrawn with a disc for the glyph.** Three bars stand for Text, a small disc before two bars for Text and glyph, a large disc for Glyph, and a disc with a pointer arrow for Reactive. `IconLabelGlyph` and `IconLabelReactive` take a viewBox cropped to their ink.
- **A version number has no "v".** The Version card reads "3.8.0" for the app and for GlimStone; the "v" belongs to the tag.
- **The New button wears `IconWhatsNew`.** The green dot stands in front of the glyph and still says whether anything is unseen.
- **A selector with long labels goes two by two on a phone.** Below 600px its segments stand two to a row, so four options make a grid of two by two. With its glyph, "Text and symbol" no longer fits half of a 360px row, and the Labels selector fell into a different layout from its neighbours.
- **A chart's second series keeps a colour the person picked.** The text-colour line without fill stays the rule while nobody has chosen, and a picked colour keeps its fill.

## 🔁 Changed

- **`IconSignIn` is turned half a turn**, so its arrow points into the door while `IconSignOut`'s leaves it. The turn is part of the path, so the ink box and the view box stay as they were.
- **Four meanings get a glyph of their own.** `IconRefresh` marks a reset to the default, and trying again, reloading and refreshing wear `IconRetry`. `IconUpload` and `IconDownload` move files, while `IconImport` and `IconExport` read in and write out. `IconCheck` keeps a test and its success, and `IconConfirm` takes Done, Confirm and Got it.
- **`IconCompressAuto` means Automatic, the app chooses.** The magic wand covers the compression the tool picks and the order an app picks for its providers. The name stays, so apps that generate from the list keep working.
- **Existing glyphs name their new buttons.** The meanings of `IconAdd`, `IconClose`, `IconPencil`, `IconTrash`, `IconPlay`, `IconForward`, `IconKey`, `IconKeyRevoke`, `IconGear`, `IconSliders`, `IconCode`, `IconApp`, `IconShieldOn` and `IconShieldOff` now cover buttons such as Create, Dismiss, Rename, Set password and Variables.
- **`IconUpdate` means Fetch an update, check for one, update now.** The check answers with `IconUpToDate` or `IconUpdateAvailable`.
- **Three meanings widen.** `IconStar` also marks a favourite, such as Community Applications' spotlight and a Favorites tab, `IconCode` also opens a console, and `IconKey` also signs in with a passkey.
- **The caption table gives more meanings their own glyph.** Apply, confirm, check, reset, restore, clear, install, import, export, update, retry and the log no longer share a drawing with a neighbour.
- **A plugin page names `html.cc-popups-on`** as the class that turns its GlimStone look on.
- **The list opens on the side the trigger's text starts from**, and ends where the trigger ends or opens above where that does not fit. It used to take the trigger's exact width.
- **A wheel or a finger moving the page past the open list closes it, as a resize does.** The page's own scroll events do not, since the list follows its trigger.
- **`value` can be `null` and `options` is optional** next to `groups`. Both widen the types, so existing call sites compile as they are.
